lines: You commented. A soldier took a post on the line, with your name on it.
hook
But until you claim that soldier, anyone could say it is theirs.
but
Step one. Open the game, and tap your soldier. Then press: This is me.
s1
Step two. Sign in with Google. The game gives you a short code.
s2
Step three. Comment that code under any post on our page.
s3
Within minutes, the bot answers. This soldier is yours.
s4
Now the soldier is yours for good. Every day, send a letter from home. Your soldier goes into the night a little safer.
letter
Want a different job? Ask for a transfer. Medic. Sniper. Machine gunner.
transfer
Read the service record. Follow the family tree. If your soldier falls, an heir takes up the rifle.
house
Claim your soldier. Comment Concord... or Hegemony. Link in bio.
cta
